verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe spawning multiple Claude Code agents that work on different parts of a task simultaneously with a lead agent coordinating and merging results, plus support for kicking off long-running tasks, running multiple tasks in parallel via cloud sessions, and scheduling recurring/overnight work (e.g., overnight CI analysis, weekly audits) that runs unattended. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-day continuous autonomous runs, hands-on/independent corroboration of a real 'fleet' of agents running for hours or days without human intervention, and concrete limits/guarantees on agent runtime duration.
